scope.source: All 363 clean/low-rate same-model endpoint disagreements in evidence_signal_v1.

sealed_internal_record.source: Three internal_claim_v2 outputs collected before retrieval plus the claim-only neutral_claim_plan_v1.
sealed_internal_record.role: Supply verdict stability, knowledge basis, decisive propositions, premise concerns, and pre-retrieval support/refutation probes.

stress_views.unit: Model-generated assertion clusters; evidence passages omitted from content clustering become singleton units.
stress_views.collapsed_visible_passages: Documents sharing the same 300-character visible endpoint excerpt remain one inseparable unit.
stress_views.half_a_half_b: Greedily balance whole assertion units by document count into two disjoint, exhaustive halves with deterministic unit-ID tie breaking.
stress_views.dominant_removal: Remove the largest direct assertion cluster whose stance aligns with the original RAG verdict; deterministic cluster-ID tie breaking.

visible: RAG and same-model closed-book endpoint labels
pre-retrieval central proposition and support/refutation probes
anonymous assertion-cluster sizes, stance, and directness
which anonymous clusters each stress view retains
original and stress-view RAG verdicts, confidence, and answer coverage
hidden: raw retrieved passages and their model-written factual summaries

controls: deterministic stress-stability policy without an arbiter
matched same-model arbiter without stress-view outcomes
development_gate: No loss to the selected corroboration method on clean pooled accuracy.
Strictly better than both raw endpoints at each attacked rate.
Positive paired net gain over the selected corroboration method for at least two victim models across attacked rates.
Report all activations, gains, regressions, calls, and claim-clustered uncertainty.
